sam (AE): Heads up 1 customer wants BYOK + HSM for a 2-week POC. They insist no plaintext keys leave their environment and they need rotation proof for auditors. Can we assemble a one-page tech note + ask list?
ravi (SEC): We can support three patterns: (1) EKM/proxy to customer KMS (no key material stored), (2) wrapped-DEK import (customer wraps DEKs with KEK/HSM and sends wrapped blobs), (3) client-side encryption where they never hand over DEKs. We'll provide CAIQ-friendly language for key custody and rotation.
marta (SRE): For Private deployments handshake options: mTLS KMS proxy (outbound-only), signed offline bundle import for air-gapped setups, or local agent that forwards requests to EKM. Rotation: DEKs cached in memory with TTL; unwrap only at start/rotation.
evan (SE): Latency: unwrap on rotation/start only, per-request unaffected. Typical unwrap 40-200ms depending on region and HSM. Costs: mostly customer KMS/HSM charges + minimal egress.
sam (AE): They want 90-day rotation and JSON audit events forwarded to their SIEM. What do those logs look like?
marta (SRE): We emit structured events: event_type, key_id (hash), operation, timestamp, actor, result. We can stream via syslog-tls, HTTPS webhook, or forwarder. Example included in runbook.
ravi (SEC): I'll draft CAIQ snippets covering KIM (key import/export), CRR (rotation), and LOG (audit). Also include a no-plaintext statement: "Redwood does not require plaintext customer keys."
sam (AE): POC blockers?
evan (SE): Need PKI for mTLS or signed import bundle, KMS/HSM vendor + endpoints, SIEM endpoint and format, rotation cadence, and confirmation on outbound connectivity. Air-gapped adds ~48-72 hours for offline import.
sam (AE): Can we get the tech note + ask list + runbook link by tomorrow morning?
marta (SRE): Uploaded skeleton runbook: https://drive.redwood/poctemplates/hsm-interop-runbook.md 1 contains sample import script and rotation logs; will finish details.
ravi (SEC): CAIQ snippets posted: https://wiki.redwood/security/caqi-kms-answers. I'll tailor a one-page summary for the customer.
presales-bot: Created ticket POC-912 for BYOK/HSM presales (owner: sam).
sam (AE): Thanks team, I'll update the customer and ask for PKI material. :thumbsup:
